newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mixed in range trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed in range trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURE PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market was mixed at the close but prices drifted in a narrow range with activity also limited by players' reluctance to trade on poor fundamentals. Trading was cautious with Aug futures trading in eight-ringgit range. Aug futures support seen at 1,220 with resistance at 1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices were little changed with interest scattered among crude palm oil. Market awaits May 1-20 exports.

"People do not want to trade heavily while waiting for fresh leads," a trader said. "Technically, the charts are holding at around current levels and if any supportive leads appear, then we will see some movements."
At the close, the August futures contract closed two ringgit down at 1,220 ringgit ($488.20) a tonne. The contract is seen trading between 1,220 and 1,250 ringgit.
Traders said there were some covering and bargain hunting at the lower levels. Gains in soyoil also helped market sentiment initially.
Physicals also saw little participation, traders said.
Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,310 against bids of 1,302.50 after trading from 1,300 to 1,305.
May (central) saw offers at 1,285 against bids 1,280. June (south) was offered at 1,297.50 versus bids at 1,292.50 with earlier trades done at 1,295 and 1,300.
June (central) saw offers at 1,277.50 versus bids at 1,272.50.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $552.50, June at $547.50, July at $540 and Aug/Sep at $537.50. May was traded at $551.50.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $590, June at $585, July at $570 and July/Aug/Sep at $565.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $415 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275.
